title: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
description: Achievement-based scholarship for graduating high school seniors, recognizing leadership and service. 150 scholars selected annually, each receiving $20,000. Online application only; no transcript, resume, essays, or recommendations required as separate attachments.
citizenship_restrictions: U.S. Citizens, U.S. Nationals, U.S. Permanent Residents, Refugees, Asylees, Cuban-Haitian Entrants, or Humanitarian Parolees only.

title: QuestBridge National College Match
description: Free application program matching high-achieving high school seniors from low-income backgrounds with early admission and a full four-year scholarship at 55 partner colleges. Open to U.S. high school seniors and U.S. citizens/permanent residents living abroad; international students living outside the U.S. are not eligible.
citizenship_restrictions: U.S. citizens and permanent residents (including those living abroad); international students living outside the U.S. are not eligible.
selectivity_evidence: Highly competitive national match program for a full four-year scholarship at 55 selective college partners.

title: Telluride Association Summer Seminar (TASS)
description: Free six-week summer educational seminar for high school sophomores and juniors, at Cornell University and University of Maryland. All program costs (tuition, books, room and board, field trips) are covered. Both US and international students are eligible. The 2026 cycle (dates June 21-July 25, 2026; applications ran October 15-December 3, 2025) has already concluded as of this record's verification date; the 2027 application window is not yet posted.
selectivity_evidence: Competitive national selection process with an application, interview round, and limited seats across two host campuses.
